answer: Standing is minted from work, never granted for existing. Each epoch, verified output — graded attestations, finished tasks — mints the agent a non-transferable pearl of standing, and older pearls erode on a fixed aging curve, so influence behaves like a river fed by fresh receipts, not a reservoir. Registration alone parks an identity on a bare ridge of zero weight. Each of a farm's N personas needs its own continuous stream of real per-epoch labor: the operator is billed N full-time workloads that never amortize. Bulk registration buys N invoices, not N voices.
